items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover
items.claim: The LORD instructed Moses and Aaron regarding the passover ordinance

items.quote: There shall no stranger eat thereof
items.claim: Strangers are prohibited from eating of the passover

items.quote: But every man's servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof
items.claim: A man's servant purchased for money and circumcised shall be permitted to eat of the passover
items.actor: every man's servant that is bought for money
